stem.text: Which statement helps to explain why water molecules are forced to move through xylem vessel elements as a consequence of transpiration?

A.text: Water molecules form hydrogen bonds with cellulose in the walls of xylem vessel elements in a process known as adhesion.

B.text: Water molecules form hydrogen bonds with neighbouring water molecules in a process known as cohesion.

C.text: Water molecules form ionic bonds with dissolved mineral ions, which helps to keep the water molecules together in a continuous column.

D.text: Water has a high latent heat of vaporisation and this prevents the evaporation of water in the xylem vessel elements.
